name: tractor_fuel
source: PHYS-033 P4 I7a C7. Identical to data/vehicles/tractor.json (chassis geometry, suspension, tyres, steering, brake_system, aero, gearbox, transfer case, both differentials, park lock, PTO, controllers all UNCHANGED - see that file's own 'source' field for their derivation) plus a fuel_tank component + fluid link. NO fuel map: PHYS-033 P4 I7a C7's owner ruling (2026-09-27) deferred a diesel fuel MAP for this engine because no source found meets the project's 'a map's fuel must be the fuel it was measured on' rule for data/engines/diesel_i4_4l5_turbo.json (itself an admitted plausible-class placeholder, not a specific measured engine - see that file's own source field: 'NOT a specific engine ... verify before citing'). The engine therefore keeps its existing crude no-map fuel model (indicated_efficiency defaults to the ignition='compression' value 0.48, Heywood 1988 section 15.5.1) unchanged; this file adds only a tank so the engine can starve/stall when it runs the tank dry, exactly like the map-less crude-model tests in tests/unit/test_engine_fuel_map.cpp's tractor cases. FUEL: fuel = ../fuels/diesel.json - already the sole entry in diesel_i4_4l5_turbo.json's 'fuels' list, so no engine-file edit was needed. TANK CAPACITY: CITED for a comparable mid-size 4.5 L 4-cylinder turbo-diesel tractor (the same engine displacement/class diesel_i4_4l5_turbo.json's own source field names, 'John Deere PowerTech 4045 / Deutz TCD 4.1 class') - tractordata.com, 'John Deere 6105M tractor information' (https://www.tractordata.com/farm-tractors/007/5/3/7530-john-deere-6105m.html): engine 'PowerTech PVX, 4.5L 4-cyl diesel', gross power '105 hp / 78.3 kW' (this project's engine file's own ~100 kW/2200 rpm rating is in the same class, not identical - the 6105M is cited as a comparable real machine's fuel tank, not as the source of the engine curve itself, which remains its own file's plausible-class placeholder), fuel tank capacity 'Fuel tank: 58 gal / 219.5 L'. DERIVED capacity_kg: 219.5 L * 830.0 kg/m^3 (data/fuels/diesel.json's own density_kg_m3) / 1000 = 182.185 kg, rounded to 182.19 kg. initial_kg = capacity_kg (a full tank) = 182.19. fluid link tank.out -> engine.fuel per docs/data_formats/vehicle.md / tests/support/fixtures/vehicle_tank_sedan.json's established syntax; the only engine/fuel_tank pairing in the vehicle, no fluid ambiguity.
